periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward diagonal tilt toward the snout relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with vertical elongation along the primary axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering towards the muzzle, creating a teardrop-like effect.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve at the posterior margin with a relatively flat profile.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Significant thickness extending approximately 35% of the visible lateral torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Gap distance between ear bases is approximately equal to the lateral width of one ear pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Predominantly rounded curvature at the apex with minimal flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-green discoloration on the white fur of the ventral neck and lower facial region.
